channel.title: Breakpoint
channel.description: Notes by Amit Vitekar on modem firmware, telecom networks, and machine-learning security.

item.title: Nine of Ten: measuring three defences in a RAG poisoning lab
item.description: A keyword filter, a perplexity score and an embedding-similarity check, measured against a RAG poisoning lab's own payloads. The filter rejects nine of ten clean documents; the check that works is imported by nothing.

item.title: The Eleventh Slot: an IMS SDP heap overflow in Exynos modem firmware
item.description: An IMS SDP heap overflow in Exynos modem firmware: locating the parser, reconstructing the dispatch chain, and reproducing the overflow from the real IMS entry point under full-system emulation.
